lin.name: Videotex Switchboard
lin.idea: Home as the map of the whole service: every page a cell with its number, a lamp and a count (a videotex sommaire), the question typed on the glass under a cursor, each page opening on the same rack with its own green summary screen

changes: a new mono for the machine and the figures (Geist Mono, Red Hat Mono, Azeret Mono, Fira Code, Spline Sans Mono or Victor Mono)
text-wrap: balance on every heading and pretty on paragraphs, so no line ends on a lonely word
a slashed or dotted zero in the monospaced face, where it has one (font-feature-settings "zero")
